title: IPC Bridge Between Rust and TypeScript
description: Command naming and type marshaling conventions.
body: The bridge between Rust and the web frontend. Every #[tauri::command] here becomes callable from TypeScript via invoke('name', { args }). Arguments and return values cross the boundary as JSON. Note the naming convention: Rust snake_case command names are invoked via that same snake_case string, but their arguments are converted to camelCase. The typed wrappers in src/bindings.ts hide that asymmetry.
